name: application-session-devices-list
title: Session Devices List
description: List of active sign-in sessions with device/browser label, location, last-active time, a badge on the current device, per-row revoke, and a sign-out-all-others action.
useWhen: Building an account security page where users can review and revoke active sign-in sessions.
You need to clearly distinguish the current device (no revoke action) from other signed-in devices (revokable).
Offering a single action to sign out of every session except the current one.
avoidWhen: You're listing API keys or programmatic credentials rather than interactive login sessions — use API Key Manager instead.
You're listing team members and their roles rather than a single user's own sessions — use a team-members list instead.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are a single flex line at all widths; on narrow viewports the location/last-active text truncates before the label or the Revoke button wraps.
accessibility: The current session is marked with a visible 'This device' badge, and its row has no Revoke button (removed entirely, not just disabled) since a user cannot revoke their own active session.
Device-type icons are decorative; the visible label ("Chrome on macOS") is the accessible identifier, not the icon shape.
The destructive 'Sign out of all other sessions' action is visually and textually distinct from the per-row Revoke buttons to avoid accidental mass sign-out.

variants.title: Session Devices List
variants.description: Three sessions: the current Chrome on macOS device (badge, no revoke), a Safari on iPhone session with a Revoke button, and a Firefox on Windows session with a Revoke button, plus a sign-out-all-others footer action.
accessibility: Only non-current sessions render a Revoke button; the current session is structurally exempt, not just visually muted.

variants.title: Session Devices List (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-session list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Badge, icon, and destructive-action colors remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
